params.name: params
params.description: Comma-separated list of parameters to retrieve. E.g. airTemperature,windSpeed,waveHeight

params.name: start
params.description: Timestamp in UTC for first forecast hour. UNIX format or URL-encoded ISO format.

params.name: end
params.description: Timestamp in UTC for last forecast hour. UNIX format or URL-encoded ISO format.

params.name: source
params.description: Specify a single source or comma-separated list of sources. E.g. noaa or dwd,noaa

items.docs: Retrieve hourly weather forecast data for a single coordinate. Returns atmospheric and marine weather parameters including temperature, wind, waves, swell, and precipitation from multiple data sources.
